claims.claim: The final evaluation completed but did not qualify; no conditional reaggregation changes this status.
The final evidence covers ten fixed benchmark cases, four Leaderboard-derived and six HELM-derived, with seeds 5003, 7001 and 9001 and budgets 8, 16 and 32.

Primary and all reference predictions are absent for Commonsense at seeds 5003 and 9001. Constant, copy, permuted and selected-item-mean structural checks fail there, while fitted uniform selection is available. The underlying exception is not identified by these records.
Common-support comparisons use 28 of 30 case-seed pairs, with Commonsense supported only at seed 7001. All other cases have three supported seeds.
Reported primary aggregate MAE is 0.08801465854359276 and RMSE 0.09789336720441476, including missing-output defaults.
Reported primary Spearman is 0.7328732236748521 and Kendall tau-b 0.5943160224743321; these include missing-record defaults.

Reported fitted-uniform MAE 0.044910877034389785, selected-mean MAE 0.10836174574059959, uniform-mean MAE 0.1335974367939037, IRT MAE 0.1186668212839868, anchor MAE 0.22047382735923254, and source-mean MAE 0.1643825693696333 have different missing-output exposure and do not form a measured-only superiority ranking.

Structural-control failure summary is 0.041666666666666664, missing-evaluation fraction is 0.011049723756906077, and checked replay maximum discrepancy is zero. The first two are evaluator-defined summaries, not rates over independent target models or case-seed pairs.

The stored primary-minus-anchor contrast is -0.0769036132600842 with endpoints [-1,1]; these are fallback endpoints because pairing is incomplete, not an informative confidence interval. Its missing-record convention differs from separately penalized marginal MAEs.
Available-pair primary MAE is lower than fitted-uniform MAE in nine cases; MedQA is the exception at 0.0574 versus 0.0530. This is descriptive and includes singleton-support Commonsense.
Conditional BBH primary and fitted-uniform MAEs are 0.0308 and 0.0570, and MATH MAEs are 0.0603 and 0.0624. MuSR anchor error is heterogeneous relative to the other cases.
Under equal-source/equal-case and within-case available-seed normalization, primary MAEs at budgets 8/16/32 are 0.0438507255604756, 0.03333117402076665 and 0.027776433747489636.
On identical common support, fitted-uniform MAEs at budgets 8/16/32 are 0.05983060181043318, 0.04388863282142454 and 0.03283671741622329.

Selected-item mean MAEs at budgets 8/16/32 are 0.13207754853140033, 0.10495817584576625 and 0.08507833899220836; uniform-mean MAEs are 0.10821494499086409, 0.08229789663800609 and 0.05556974653061864. Uniform raw means have lower MAE at every displayed budget, whereas fitted selection reverses the conditional ordering.

Conditional primary Spearman correlations at budgets 8/16/32 are 0.7787133623969075, 0.8485275353348883 and 0.8858252382784845. Selected-mean correlations are 0.7805746798716318, 0.8461155247695583 and 0.8818752839767907. Reconstruction changes absolute-score error much more than ranking in this retained evidence, without isolating a particular reconstruction component.

All numerical cells of supplementary case and budget tables and both quantitative figures are deterministic transformations of recorded final target means and predictions on their declared common support. Seed dots are descriptive, with overlapping model populations, and are not confidence intervals.

The supplementary seed table retains every primary case-seed record, recorded target/group counts, and budget-averaged MAE/RMSE/Spearman/Kendall. Missing rows remain missing. The exhaustive CSV separates each budget, condition and reference with availability/structural status, using the evaluator's zero rank-correlation convention for exactly constant vectors.

The remaining reported diagnostic MAEs are 0.22204546910278564 for constant observations, 0.15448451324975213 for copied observations, 0.1005045540030643 for permuted observations and 0.02807015578570595 for the single checked replay; they are not ordinary independent target-accuracy estimates.

The evaluated source-only selector uses equal total group weights, empirical score covariance, diagonal nugget 0.1 max(mu(1-mu),0.05), and greedy squared conditional covariance divided by conditional item variance floored at 1e-12. It uses low-rank updates and no target-adaptive acquisition.
claims.grounding_note: Registry id identifies the delivered configuration only; readable code is substantive support, not the metric value or hash.

claims.claim: The linear branch fits row-unweighted centered ridge regression with an intercept and shrinkage. Per-budget strength grid is 0.1/1/10 and shrinkage grid 0/0.5/1, selected by group-weighted source-held-out squared error.

The source profile branch fixes smoothed-logit abilities, initializes difficulties from clipped group-weighted item means, and uses eight bounded Newton updates with difficulty penalty 0.01. It is not joint or conditional maximum-likelihood Rasch estimation.

Profiles interpolate Rasch probabilities with binary source responses and clip at 1e-6. Each source contributes five ability-offset particles with offsets h*(-2,-1,0,1,2) and prior proportions (1,4,6,4,1)/16; total mass is equal per source group.

Posterior normalization uses log-sum-exp and adds the exact observed total to the expected unqueried total. Every prefix recomputes from the original prior; the posterior is not a calibrated empirical uncertainty interval.

At most three group-disjoint source folds choose residual weight 0/0.5/0.75, offset scale 0/0.5 and blend 0/0.5/1, by group-balanced MAE across budgets, with simpler tie-breaking. One-group fallback is ridge strength one, shrinkage one and zero profile blend. No final fitted blend logs or independent final component ablations are available.

The uniform fitted control changes acquisition and refits/tunes reconstruction. The selected-mean control returns the raw mean on the primary order. The uniform mean uses the same prescribed seeded uniform order as the fitted uniform control. These compare configured procedures or whole reconstruction, not isolated particle or selector effects.

The evaluator uses seed-hashed approximately 70/30 model-group splits and equal source-domain, within-domain case, seed and budget weights. Metadata grouping is conservative and cannot prove full training-lineage separation.

The anchor reference clusters centered normalized response vectors using one initialization and at most 30 iterations; scores are representative responses weighted by nearest-representative assignments. This is a local reference, not an exact published reproduction.

The IRT reference uses a penalized 2PL model, L-BFGS-B with at most 40 iterations and information-ranked fixed items, followed by up to 30 regularized Newton ability updates. It averages full-universe model probabilities and is not an exact tinyBenchmarks reproduction.

Identical queried response rows receive the same estimator output without target identity/group inputs. The prevalence of indistinguishable target pairs is not measured; this is a source-inspectable interface property, not a new theorem or empirical finding.

Prior permitted work covers representative anchors, efficient benchmark score estimation, sparse ability-based benchmarks, reference-instance assessors and learned evaluation acquisition. These citations provide context, not performance measurements for this study.
claims.grounding_note: Permitted exact-DOI metadata and abstracts were inspected; see reference_consultation.md. No citation-graph traversal or prohibited-source identification was used.

claims.claim: Open LLM Leaderboard and HELM are the named upstream evaluation collections. Their documentation provides context, not evidence for staged case identities, counts, filtering or snapshot equivalence.

The Rasch response family has logistic ability-minus-difficulty form with common unit discrimination; the 2PL family permits item-specific discrimination and has item information a^2 p(1-p). These foundations do not certify the custom fitting procedure or establish a profile-component benefit.
